name: 41040 · Falmouth, KY
findings: ZIP 41040 (Falmouth) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 41040 (Falmouth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 41040 (Falmouth) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.
